K=1 independent acceptance pass rates. The k1-stage0-acceptance-v2 experiment. (A) Double-well
recovery. (B) Pure-noise negative control. (C) Single-well negative control. (D)
Shared-baseline missing-cell design; a pass is the required typed non-identifiable-design
abstention. Black points show replicate pass rates for each feature count; Open points identify
incomplete frozen cells; The red horizontal line marks the frozen 90% pass-rate gate. The
estimand is Pass rate uses every requested replicate as its denominator; execution failures are
failures.. Cell adjudication additionally requires a Wilson 95% lower bound of at least 80%.
The displayed execution is incomplete and cannot establish acceptance. A complete cell passes
only at 90% or greater with a Wilson 95% lower bound of at least 80%. This figure summarizes
frozen known-truth controls and does not by itself establish biological validity.
